item.title: Attorney General Ellison sues Texas Governor Abbott to compel extradition of ICE agent Christian Castro
item.description:
Publication Date: August 17, 2026

Castro is charged with four counts of second-degree assault and one count of falsely reporting a crime for allegedly shooting into an occupied house during Operation Metro Surge, striking someone in the leg, and lying about the shooting
